trickyParts: Waiters try the lock on descriptor 8 and dup it to 9 only after flock succeeds, so lock_holders (which scans descriptor 9) sees only real holders.
Under -allow-foreign a URL flag whose value is not a URL is refused naming only the flag, so an error never echoes a keyword/value connection string with its password.
